Ryan (CTO): Dropping a follow-up thread for runtime q&a from today's all-hands. Keep Qs short and we'll tag owners.
Sophie (Runtime Eng): I'll take batching / cache questions. Mention route vs pool-level if relevant.
Jules (EngOps): Quick: what's the trigger for switching from a long-wait batch to immediate flush? Is it time, queue depth, or SLO tag?
Sophie (Runtime Eng): Primary trigger is max_wait_ms per-route, then queue-depth heuristics + SLO tag override. Example: latency routes honor max_wait_ms aggressively, throughput routes favor larger batches.
Tomas (Kernel Eng): On kernel side: we're rolling out a lower-memory attention kernel that saves ~30% GPU scratch for 8k contexts but needs slightly different launch configs. We plan canary next week.
Mira (SRE): Will the canary JIT cost cause p95 spikes? We saw a 200-300ms blip last time when a new kernel JITed.
Tomas (Kernel Eng): Good call. We'll pre-warm the PTX cache on canary nodes and gate JITs behind async threads to avoid blocking.
Priya (Product): For Console UX: proposal is a simple slider (latency <-> throughput) per route, and an "advanced" YAML editor for power users. Does that map cleanly to runtime signals?
Sophie (Runtime Eng): Yes. Slider maps to a small set of knobs: max_wait_ms, batch_window_pct, and fallback aggressiveness. We'll publish mapping doc.
Jules (EngOps): Can someone paste a tiny YAML example we can use in the runbook?
Sophie (Runtime Eng): Paste: ```route: /api/chat/small-latency
slo: p95<120ms
batching:
  max_wait_ms: 8
  max_batch_tokens: 1024
fallbacks:
  - kernel_swap
  - reduce_batch_window
  - model_variant: quant-8
```
Mira (SRE): Action: schedule canary cluster with pre-warm step + monitoring dashboard for jit/p95/p99. I'll handle.
Tomas (Kernel Eng): I'll drop the microbench table (seq-len x batch perf) to #kernel today so teams can see expected gains.
Priya (Product): I'll add the slider & advanced editor mock to the Console RFC and aim for feature-flagged beta in ~6 weeks.
reminder-bot: Follow-up created: ah-runtime-post-qna (owners: Sophie, Tomas, Priya, Jules, Mira).
Ryan (CTO): Thanks all. We'll collect these into an FAQ and link it from the all-hands notes. If small follow-ups, keep them here. :thumbsup:
